<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Invisible Man''' is one of [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba|Fortuneteller Baba]]'s fighters, and he really is invisible: nothing of him is drawn in game. He is one of the four contenders of [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament]] at [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Palace|Baba's Palace]] on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]], and one of Baba's fighters in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
The Invisible Man is one of the four contenders of Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament, together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Fangs the Vampire|Fangs the Vampire]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Akkuman|Akkuman]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Mummy|Mummy]]. The contenders come in random order and get 10% stronger for every round already played; after them come the [[Special:MyLanguage/Masked Warrior|Masked Warrior]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Goku|Kid Goku]]. His default stats for the first round are:
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:9--> Stage</translate> !! <translate><!--T:10--> Health / melee / ki</translate> !! <translate><!--T:11--> AI tier</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:12--> Contender</translate> || 140 / 14 / 10 || <translate><!--T:13--> Novice</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:14-->
Bouts end at knockout, so nobody dies. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
'''Invisibility:''' the Invisible Man's texture is fully transparent and the game also flags him as invisible, so you can't see him at any point of the fight.

<!--T:17-->
He doesn't fly and has no ki attacks: he fights with melee only, so his ki damage goes unused. In the tournament he fights on the '''Novice''' AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
The [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest '''Baba's Fighters: Invisible Man''' (quest 25) has you defeat him at Fortuneteller Baba's Palace.
</translate>
